eduFinanceTagline: Verified school fees. Responsible financing. Complete reconciliation.
eduFinanceDescription: A partner-led infrastructure workflow connecting parents and guardians, schools and authorized lending institutions. The parent or legally authorized guardian is the borrower; the student is the education beneficiary.
eduFinanceBorrower: The parent or legally authorized guardian is the normal borrower. Student beneficiaries are not borrowers and should not be used as credit-scoring proxies. Only the minimum necessary student reference should be processed.
eduFinancePartner: School and invoice verification, credit decisions, loan funding and lending obligations remain with the relevant verified school and authorized lending institution. Payment execution depends on an appropriately authorized provider.
eduFinanceControls: TITech supplies infrastructure and records. It does not independently accept deposits, lend, hold tuition funds, make unauthorized credit decisions, execute payments or distribute insurance.
eduFinanceCurrentState: This page is informational. Application intake and all live financial actions remain disabled by default until partner, legal, privacy, security and operational gates are evidenced.
eduFinanceAvailability: Any future offer, price, eligibility, agreement, disbursement or repayment arrangement must be provided by the responsible authorized lender under approved terms. This page is not a loan offer, credit approval or guarantee.
